blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createPricePreferencesStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step creates one or more price preferences.

```ts
const data = createPricePreferencesStep([{
  attribute: "region_id",
  value: "reg_123",
  is_tax_inclusive: true
}])
```

children.name: attribute
children.description: The attribute of the price preference. For example, `region_id` or `currency_code`.

children.name: value
children.description: The value of the price preference. For example, `reg_123` or `usd`.

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description:
Whether prices matching this preference are tax inclusive.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/pricing/tax-inclusive-pricing).

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of a price preference.

children.name: attribute
children.description: The rule attribute for the preference

children.name: value
children.description: The rule value for the preference

children.name: is_tax_inclusive
children.description: Flag specifying whether prices for the specified rule are tax inclusive.

children.name: created_at
children.description: When the price preference was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: When the price preference was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: When the price preference was deleted.
